scan_table_check.description: State Flows are an outdated (yet not deprecated) and not well-supported pattern to control what happens if a task changes from one state to another. There are several flaws in the implementation that causes problems when deploying State Flow records from one instance to another. During execution State Flows are perceived to be slow and inefficient.
scan_table_check.name: CodeSanity - State Flows
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Replace State Flows by scripted Business Rules that respond to changes of the state value. One option is to refactor process implementations according to the pattern produced by x_snc_devtools.AppBuilderImplementBusinessProcess().
